fields.description: Stored as Text Editor (not HTML) -- Frappe's "HTML" fieldtype is a no_value_field with no DB column (see frappe.model.no_value_fields); it can only render static markup from the DocType itself, never store or return per-row data. Text Editor is the standard Frappe fieldtype for a DB-persisted, Desk-editable rich-HTML field, which is what get_consent actually needs to read back per language.
fields.label: Consent

fields.description: Structured checkbox items shown below the consent body (e.g. the mandatory digital-health-services consent, the optional telemedicine-sharing consent) -- get_consent returns these as `items` so the client renders real checkboxes instead of embedding "[ ] ..." text in `consent` itself. Reused as-is on Shukhee Consent Version (see that doctype) -- reads of this child table MUST filter on both parenttype and parent, since both parent doctypes autoincrement their own `name` independently and their ids collide.
fields.label: Consent Items

fields.description: Bumped whenever this row's `consent` copy is edited in the Desk UI, so a client can log which exact copy version the patient saw (see Shukhee Consent Log.consent_version) -- an edit here takes effect for the very next call (get_consent has no caching), so the version is what lets an audit trail distinguish which wording was actually shown.
fields.label: Version
Current Version
fields.description: The Shukhee Consent Version row holding an immutable snapshot of this row's current `consent`/`version` -- maintained automatically (see ShukheeConsent.on_update), never set by hand. This is what Call Logs.consent_version / Shukhee Consent Log.consent_version actually resolve to, not this row directly, since this row keeps getting overwritten in place on every edit.
